learning_objective: 🎯 Let us build a time machine and learn how to talk about yesterday, today, and right now!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We use Simple Present for things we do every day like a habit! I brush my teeth. The sun rises. If it is a He, She, or It, we add a magic s to the verb, like He plays.
Past Tense is for the time machine going backwards! It tells us about things that are finished. We usually add ed to the verb. I played in the park yesterday.
This tense is for actions happening right at this very second! We use a helping verb (is/am/are) and add ing to the action. I am reading a book right now!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Time Machine Act!
fun_activity.instructions: Make three signs: Yesterday, Every Day, and Right Now. When someone holds up Yesterday, say I jumped. For Every Day, say I jump. For Right Now, act it out and say I am jumping!

quick_recap: ⭐ Tenses tell us the time of an action.
⭐ Simple Present is for everyday habits.
⭐ Simple Past uses ed for things that are already done.
⭐ Present Continuous uses ing for things happening right now.
